read_notes: The naive pd.read_csv(path) also yields the correct 11284x78 shape - there are no ragged rows, no Unnamed columns, no embedded newlines and no thousands separators. encoding='utf-8-sig' is specified to strip the UTF-8 BOM on the 'Sr No' header explicitly rather than relying on pandas' C-parser doing it. dtype=str is required because column 65 ('Test extract') triggers a mixed-type warning and because pincode/Zipcode otherwise become floats.
row_count_explanation: wc -l reports 11285. That is 1 header line + 11284 data records. The file uses CRLF line endings and terminates with a newline; csv.reader yields exactly 11284 records, all with exactly 78 fields, and no record contains an embedded newline. No gap to explain.
encoding_notes: UTF-8 with BOM (EF BB BF) before the 'Sr No' header. CRLF line endings.

duplicates.method: exact = pandas duplicated() over all 78 columns. near_dupe_name_geo = uppercase name with punctuation and generic tokens (HOSPITAL/CLINIC/CENTRE/PVT/LTD/PRIVATE/LIMITED/AND/THE) stripped, joined to API lat/lon rounded to 4dp (~11 m). 23 groups of 2, of which manual inspection confirms 22 are genuine re-entries of the same facility (adjacent Sr No, same email/address) and 1 ('Satellite Hospital', Jodhpur, rows 9550/9551) is a false positive from two distinct facilities sharing a city-centroid geocode.

geo_quality.recommendation: Use API Latitude/API Longitude as authoritative. It has strictly better India-bbox validity (11281 vs 11246) and is not contaminated by name-based geocoding. Fall back to gmaps only for the 3 rows where API is out of bbox and gmaps is not. Never average the two: they disagree by >500 km on 192 rows.

candidate_primary_key.notes: Unique across all 11284 rows, monotonically increasing, but it is a positional ordinal running 1..11285 with 253 absent - not a stable PMJAY facility identifier. No natural key exists: the closest is (Manual Hospital Name, Manual District, Manual state) which still collides on 310 rows. There is NO source-issued facility ID column in this dataset.

specialty_findings.codebook_conclusion: NO. The text columns 'Specialities Empanelled' / 'Specialities Upgraded' do NOT decode the numeric codes - they contain the SAME M#/S# tokens as the one-hot columns. This dataset therefore cannot supply the PMJAY/NHA specialty codebook. An external source is required.
specialty_findings.combined_column_rule: Specialities_Upgraded_or_Empanelled == Empanelled + Upgraded as a raw string concatenation with no delimiter (11141/11284 exact match); it is null on exactly the 143 rows where Empanelled == '-NA-' (100% rule).

er_readiness.recommended_blocking_key: (Manual state, Manual District, normalised Hospital Name)
er_readiness.notes: Only 37 rows (0.33%) fail the name+geo+district+state blocking key, and all 37 fail solely on a missing Manual District - they still have name, state and a valid point, so they remain matchable on a relaxed key. Use 'Hospital Name' NOT 'Manual Hospital Name' for matching: the manual column had location qualifiers stripped and collides on 13.20% of rows vs 7.90%.
